claim_boundary: This contract fixes the accepted outcome-free image blocking and four analytical pair-sampling rules. The official seed and image-role allocation are now frozen, but no formal pair has been sampled, no reviewer packet is authorized, and no PF-ERI performance has been established.

image_allocation.quality_bottleneck: minimum deterministic direction-corrected percentile rank across native_pixel_count, sharpness_measure, and inverse exposure_clipping_fraction; the clipping field retains its channel-extreme construct caveat
image_allocation.allocation_method: largest-remainder integer transportation quotas with exact role totals, followed by seeded random permutation within cell
image_allocation.tie_break: ascending cryptographic hash of contract_version, official_seed, role, and cell_id

common_pair_retrieval_strata.best_rank_definition: minimum candidate_rank across every frozen membership of the canonical pair
common_pair_retrieval_strata.descriptor_pair_score_definition: maximum descriptor_similarity across available directions for one canonical pair and descriptor before conversion to a within-descriptor, within-role-frame percentile

development.cells: common retrieval stratum crossed with measurement_failure, evidence_stress, or ordinary
development.allocation: near-equal seeded hash-ordered water filling across nonempty cells, then seeded simple random sampling without replacement within cell

calibration.allocation: Hamilton largest-remainder proportional allocation, then seeded simple random sampling without replacement within cell

deployment_confirmation.allocation: Hamilton largest-remainder proportional allocation, then seeded simple random sampling without replacement within cell
deployment_confirmation.primary_weighted_estimator: Hajek-normalized inverse-probability-weighted mean when inclusion probabilities differ

mechanism_confirmation.sampling_frame: confirmation pairs remaining after deployment sample is immutable
mechanism_confirmation.cells: challenge class crossed with three best-rank bands
mechanism_confirmation.allocation: near-equal seeded hash-ordered water filling across nonempty cells, then seeded simple random sampling without replacement within cell

allocation_tie_break: ascending cryptographic hash of contract_version, official_seed, analytical_role, and cell_id
sparse_cell_rule: Do not redefine or merge cells. Seeded hash-ordered water filling skips exhausted cells; proportional allocation uses fixed largest remainder. Stop with INSUFFICIENT_FRAME_CAPACITY if the requested total cannot be filled.
replacement_rule: No post-outcome substitution. Any reserve order must be generated from the same pre-outcome within-cell random permutation and frozen with the primary sample.
required_pre_seed_audits: complete retained automatic image measurements for all 3000 images
outcome-free image-strata preflight with exact 1000-per-role feasibility
required_post_image_allocation_pre_pair_: complete frozen automatic pair measurements for every eligible within-role pair
zero image and canonical-pair crossing audit
